messages.author: 9403604069d4685f
messages.subject: Comparing models with M2?
parts:
Dear Phil,

I was wondering would it make sense to compare the fit of two models using the M2 statistic instead of the G2 statistic in the anova function, or would that be wrong?

Also, if the table is too sparse to calculate the p-value of the G2 statistic reliably, does it make sense to use the anova function to compare the fit of that model to another model using G2?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Comparing models with M2?
parts:
You could compare models this way, nothing theoretically stops it as the theory is quite similar. Though anova() is finding the different in the log-likelihood values not the G2 values for the exact reason that you mention. 

Phil
